deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the slice through the tumour 'illustrates this', linking the slice to the preceding statement about explanting tumours. The source text does not state that the slice illustrates explanting.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

deficiencies.description: In the text, the surprise was that HeLa cells successfully grew in culture ('did that'), because primary cells do not grow in culture. The rewrite omits 'did that' and uses 'and so', changing the cause of the surprise to the fact that HeLa cells were the first tumour cells to grow in culture.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So when HeLa cells, which were the first tumor cells to grow in culture, did that, this was very much a surprise.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: HeLa cells were the first tumour cells to grow in culture, and so this was very much a surprise.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: Dropping the word 'really' is an allowed removal of conversational emphasis/filler rather than the removal of a scientific hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'other things' as 'other components' uses different words with the same meaning in context, which is allowed.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: Omitted as an aside to the audience / meta-commentary, which is allowed.
